title: Dynamic Range Sum Queries
statement:
Given an array of $n$ integers, your task is to process $q$ queries of the following types:
1. update the value at position $k$ to $u$
2. what is the sum of values in range $[a,b]$?
inputFormat:
The first input line has two integers $n$ and $q$.
The second line has $n$ integers.
Finally, $q$ lines describe the queries.
outputFormat: Print the result of each query of type 2.
